newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust broker deal seen late in cycle.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust broker deal seen late in cycle.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp has agreed to pay a hefty price for Baltimore-based broker Alex. Brown Inc, a firm whose earnings may have reached a cyclical peak in 1996, analysts said on Monday.
"Alex. Brown has a trend of earnings which is predominantly a mirror of the long bull market that we've seen in the 1990s," said analyst George Salem of Gerard Klauer Mattison.
Analysts who heard a company conference call said Bankers Trust was well aware that brokerage earnings can be volatile.

Perrin Long, an independent analyst, said it may well be that both Bankers Trust and Alex. Brown were acting now because they wanted to be certain of finding a merger partner each thought was a good fit. With a wave of mergers among U.S. financial companies expected in the next few years, the institutions available for partnerships as time passed might not be as well-capitalized or prestigious, he said.
"I think Alex. Brown will make a great contribution to Bankers Trust over the years," Long said.
